name: Thun'grim Firegaze
summary: Atop Thorn Hill, Thun'grim Firegaze keeps to a reclusive life and a solitary forge. After their first lessons in defense, Horde warriors cross the Barrens to find him and seek steel fit for their growing skill.

sections.title: The Hermit on the Ridge
sections.body: After you show skill in the defensive arts under veteran trainers like Uzzek, you are sent to sharpen your fighting with suitable steel. Ordinary armories can carry a frontline fighter only so far. True mastery calls for a personal weapon from a smith of renown. In the Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze is that smith, an aging orc who has left settlement life behind to keep an isolated forge high above the plains.

sections.title: A Life in the Forge Fire
sections.body: Thun'grim Firegaze lives atop Thorn Hill, a jagged rise east of the Crossroads where wild raptors and hostile quilboar roam. He spends his solitary hours shaping metal, far from the protection of town walls. Decades of gazing into blistering forge flames have ruined his eyesight, though his instincts remain sharp. When you climb the heights and disturb his solitude, Firegaze knows why: a warrior has come seeking forged steel.

faq.q: Who sends warriors to find Thun'grim Firegaze?
faq.answer: Uzzek, a warrior trainer along the road near the Far Watch Post in the eastern Barrens, sends you after you demonstrate your defensive training.
Thun'grim lives at an isolated campsite atop Thorn Hill, a high ridge directly east of the Crossroads in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim live out in the hills alone?
faq.answer: Thun'grim has devoted his life to metalcraft, away from town distractions. He works alone at his anvil atop Thorn Hill despite the dangerous beasts and quilboar on the surrounding ridges.

faq.q: What happened to Thun'grim Firegaze's eyes?
faq.answer: Decades of relentless work over glowing coals and exposure to intense forge heat have largely ruined Thun'grim Firegaze's vision.

faq.q: What comes after meeting Thun'grim Firegaze?
faq.answer: After you report to Thun'grim, he recognizes your need for arms and asks you to gather raw materials so he can craft a weapon.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
faq.answer: No. This path is for Horde warriors seeking specialized arms.

angles.text: As a young Horde warrior, you are sent into the wilds to find Thun'grim and earn a signature forged weapon to complement your battle training.
Thun'grim follows a solitary orcish tradition of blacksmithing, enduring isolation and blindness to shape hot metal into lethal tools.
The Horde depends on seasoned artisans whose quality steel arms the frontline soldiers defending Kalimdor.
